dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Fischl's rebuttal totally rocked! It was so dramatic and so powerful! I didn't want to interrupt her, or I would've started blasting out a backing track!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: The stage is set up and everyone's here together. Love this feeling!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Let's celebrate this special occasion together!
